xna-type.name: EffectProcessor
xna-type.summary: Processes a string representation to a platform-specific compiled effect.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of EffectProcessor.

property.name: DebugMode
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual EffectProcessorDebugMode DebugMode { get; set; }

property.name: Defines
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual string Defines { get; set; }

method.name: Process
method.summary: Processes the string representation of the specified effect into a platform-specific binary format using the specified context.

overload.summary: Processes the string representation of the specified effect into a platform-specific binary format using the specified context.

parameters.parameter: The effect string to be processed.
